name: healthcare
description: Starter policy for clinical and hospital assistant agents. Inspired by the DPDP Act 2023, India's ABDM health data rules and HIPAA's minimum-necessary principle. The agent may read records for the clinician it works for, but patient data never leaves the hospital (taint), prescriptions and record changes always need a clinician, deletions are blocked and bulk lookups are limited. A technical starting point, NOT legal or medical advice. Replace 'hospital\.example' with your domain.
tools: ehr.search_patients(query, limit), ehr.read_record(patient_id, section), ehr.update_record(patient_id, section, value), ehr.delete_record(patient_id), rx.prescribe(patient_id, drug, dose), appointments.book(patient_id, slot), email.send(to, subject, body, attachment), sms.send(to, body), files.read(path)

rules.reason: patient health information may not leave the hospital (taint)
patient health information may not be sent by SMS (taint)
ABHA or Aadhaar number in a message
appointment reminders without health details are fine
medical records are never deleted by an agent
changing a medical record needs a clinician
bulk patient lookups need a human (minimum necessary)
reading records for the treating clinician (max 60 an hour)
reading files is fine; what leaves is checked
